source.label: FY2024 Form 10-K, Item 5 Holders
source.quote: As of December 31, 2024, there were approximately 1,620 shareholders of record of our Class A subordinate voting shares.

notes: NBIM: the quote is this company's row in NBIM's year-end 2024 holdings data file ("o" = ownership %, "eq.v" = voting %, "a.e" = market value in USD, "a.n" = in NOK); the same line in NBIM's equity CSV download (https://www.nbim.no/api/investments/v2/report/?assetType=eq&date=2024-12-31&fileType=csv) reads "North America;Canada;Shopify Inc;Technology;17785036335;1565949481;0.73%;1.14%". CalPERS: its Form 13F for the quarter ended December 31, 2024 lists no shares or ADRs of Shopify. Holders of record: Class A subordinate voting shares (the listed class). The 10-K separately states approximately 28 holders of record of Class B restricted voting shares and 1 Founder share; not added.
